ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Corporate and notarial base: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), arts. 4 (minimum capital), 9 (registered office), 20–23 (incorporation deed and registration), 178–179 (single-member company); Código de Comercio arts. 16–24 (commercial registry). AML/CFT core statutes: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended by Ley 19/2021, Ley 18/2022 and Ley 6/2023; implementing Reglamento approved by Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo; Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril (transposition of Directive (EU) 2018/843/AMLD5); Single Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register (Registro Central de Titulares Reales, RTR) created by Ley 6/2023, de 20 de marzo, amending arts. 20–25 of Ley 10/2010 and the Registro Mercantil regulation (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil, arts. 53–54). UBO definition: Ley 10/2010 art. 4.2 — any natural person owning or controlling more than 25% of capital or voting rights, or exercising control through any other means; where no natural person is identifiable, senior management must be declared. RTR filing duty (art. 25.6–25.8 Ley 10/2010, as amended by Ley 6/2023): the SL must file UBO data in the RTR within 10 business days after incorporation registration and keep the file current. KYC documentary framework: Orden EHA/2963/2008, de 1 de octubre (identification and documentation procedures); SEPBLAC guidance; Ley Orgánica 3/2018 (GDPR transposition) governs restricted access to UBO data.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin-country tax authority (e.g., IRS, HMRC, local Hacienda)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Recent bank reference / relationship letter (less than 90 days old) for UBOs and corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin-country bank maintaining the primary account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille/legalization not strictly required; accepted by Spanish bank as supplementary KYC if apostilled where demanded

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Presented as part of the notarial incorporation deed; no separate apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory controls per Ley 10/2010 arts. 11, 14–15 and Real Decreto 304/2014: (i) adverse PEP screening of all UBOs, directors and account signatories at onboarding and on a continuous basis; (ii) screening against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (Regulations (EU) 269/2010, 267/2012, 2580/2001), the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and OFAC SDN List (relevant for USD SWIFT wires); (iii) domestic SEPBLAC risk indicators and Banco de España guidance; (iv) negative-media and source-of-funds verification for PEP-adjacent persons; (v) mandatory escalation to enhanced due diligence upon any sanction or PEP hit; (vi) simplified due diligence permitted for the Low_Risk_Standard tier under Ley 10/2010 art. 32, subject to preserved electronic screening evidence and counsel sign-off.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) — 'Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social' issued electronically through the Colegio de Registradores de España (www.registradores.org) and the Ministry of Justice / Registradores e-Office (Sede Electrónica)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SL denomination may be formed in Spanish or in any official language of an EU Member State (LSC art. 404.2 and art. 407); translations or transliterations into Latin script are required where the name originates in a non-Latin alphabet, and sworn translation may be demanded by the notary and the RMC. Names must respect Spanish orthographic and accent rules; the statutory suffix 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'S.L.' (or 'S.L.U.' if single-member) must appear in the full corporate name. The name must not be contrary to law, morality or public order (LSC art. 404.1) and must not mislead as to the corporate form, nationality, activity or seat.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Denominations identical or phonetically/orthographically similar to an existing registered Spanish company (LSC art. 408 similarity bar)

'España', 'Estado', 'Gobierno', 'Nacional', 'Generalitat', 'Ayuntamiento', 'Ministerio', 'Oficial' and other institutional or sovereign tokens (require prior authorization from the competent public authority)
'Banco', 'Caja', 'Crédito', 'Financiera', 'Bolsa', 'Sociedad de Valores' and similar banking/financial tokens (require prior Banco de España or Ministry of Finance authorization)
'Seguros', 'Reaseguros', 'Mutualidad', 'Correduría' and insurance-sector tokens (require prior Dirección General de Seguros authorization)
Reserved corporate-form suffixes: 'Sociedad Anónima', 'S.A.', 'S.L.', 'S.L.U.', 'Sociedad Comanditaria', 'Cooperativa', 'Fundación' — prohibited unless used as the true statutory form
Foreign geographic names or demonyms that falsely suggest seat, nationality or official sponsorship

Terms contrary to Spanish public order, morality or dignity (LSC art. 404.1) or misleading as to the industrial activity (e.g., false '1:18 die-cast' claim would be a consumer/competition issue but naming must remain neutral)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The RMC emits a 'certificación negativa' (negative name certificate) valid for 90 days (3 months); the notarial deed of incorporation must be executed within this window. No formal extension exists — upon lapse, a fresh application is required. If the RMC rejects the proposed denomination for identity or phonetic similarity, counsel submits a new application listing up to 5 alternative names in priority order; the first available certified. The formal remedy is an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) lodged with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (Ministerio de Justicia) within one month from notification, per arts. 121–122 of Ley 39/2015, followed by judicial review (recurso contencioso-administrativo) before the Audiencia Nacional after exhaustion of the administrative route. In practice, presenting 2–3 distinctive alternative denominations is faster than litigating a rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally Permissible — LSC art. 9 requires the statutory registered office (domicilio social) to be in Spain, at the place of effective administration or principal establishment. A purely virtual correspondence address is not a valid domicilio social unless the company genuinely operates at that address; a mail-forwarding virtual office may be used as an ancillary communications address. For a zinc-alloy die-casting manufacturer, a real physical production and/or warehouse site in Spain is required for commercial substance, bank onboarding and tax (AEAT) acceptance. Recommended structure: physical production site as statutory seat, with virtual office permitted solely for commercial correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate — 15–25% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection in the die-casting sector: Registro Mercantil substance visits are rare (under 5%); however, labor (Inspección de Trabajo y Seguridad Social) and environmental authorities (industrial furnaces, emissions, waste) conduct unannounced inspections at metalworking premises with 20–40% likelihood; AML/CFT (SEPBLAC) inspection probability for the Low_Risk_Standard tier is negligible at under 5%.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital; Articles 4-5 (minimum capital), 21-23 (incorporation deed), 62 (paid-up capital), 78 (fully subscribed), 33-34 (registration). Complementary rules: Real Decreto 1784/1996 (Commercial Registry Regulations) and Notarial Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (the provincial Mercantile Registry located at the company's registered office); name clearance at Registro Mercantil Central.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (notarial public deed of incorporation) filed with the Provincial Mercantile Registry, together with the Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social (name clearance certificate).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and paid-up capital is EUR 3,000 (Article 4 LSC). The capital must be fully subscribed and paid in at incorporation. Cash contributions must be evidenced by a Spanish bank certificate of deposit; no formal escrow account is required. Non-cash contributions must be described in the deed and supported by a valuation report as required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST GENERAL MEETING OF SHAREHOLDERS OF [COMPANY NAME], S.L.: First, the founding shareholders unanimously accept and approve the subscription of the entire share capital, divided into 3,000 equal participations of EUR 1.00 each, all fully paid in cash as certified by the bank deposit certificate. Second, the registered office is established at [street address], Madrid, Spain, and that address is declared as the statutory domicile for all commercial, tax, and administrative purposes. Third, the following officers are appointed: [Name] as Sole Administrator, and [Name] as Joint Administrator, each acting with joint and several powers. The administrators are authorized to execute all formalities before the Mercantile Registry and tax authorities. The resolution is adopted unanimously.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en_word: This narrative is approximately 110 words; omitted from JSON to preserve schema.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance application (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name clearance application online through the RMC website or at the corresponding provincial Mercantile Registry. Provide up to three proposed corporate names. The RMC verifies that the proposed name does not coincide with an existing company name and issues a negative name certificate.
required_dossiers: Duly completed name clearance application form
Identity documents (DNI/NIE/passport) of each founding shareholder
If shareholder is a legal entity, certificate of incorporation and good standing from its home registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RMC returns a 'coincidencia' (conflict) notification, file a new application with an alternative name. No application fee is forfeited. A formal appeal may be lodged with the RMC if the objection is contested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial execution of the deed of incorporation and capital deposit verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (Notaría) appointed by the founders; bank required for capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the name certificate, the founders execute the public deed of incorporation before a Spanish notary. The notary verifies the identity and legal capacity of founders, confirms the capital payment certificate, and incorporates the articles of association. The deed is signed before the notary and included in the notarial protocol.
required_dossiers: Name clearance certificate from the RMC
Draft deed of incorporation and articles of association
Bank certificate proving deposit of at least EUR 3,000 in a Spanish bank account
Identity documents and NIE numbers of all founding shareholders
If foreign corporate shareholder, authenticated corporate documents and powers of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a defect in the proposed deed, the founders amend and re-execute the draft. If the bank certificate is defective, obtain a corrected certificate. If a non-cash contribution is intended and the valuation is questioned, obtain an expert valuation report required under Article 67 LSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial corresponding to the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a certified copy and the original deed of incorporation to the Provincial Mercantile Registry. The Registrar reviews formal legality (formalidades legales) of the deed and registers the company. The company acquires legal personality upon registration.
required_dossiers: Original notarial deed (primera copia) and certified duplicate
Tax identification number application (NIF provisional form)
Proof of payment of registry fees
Notarial certification of the bank deposit for capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a negative qualification (nota de calificación), correct the defect by means of a rectification deed executed before a notary and re-present the instrument. A negative decision may be appealed to the Registro Mercantil Central or the competent Juzgado de lo Mercantil.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Final tax identification and employer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the local AEAT office for the provisional NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) using Form 036/037. After registration in the Mercantile Registry, request the definitive NIF. Simultaneously, register as an employer with the TGSS for social security contribution purposes.
required_dossiers: Copy of the insription from the Provincial Mercantile Registry
NIE or passport of the legal representative
Bank account details for social security contributions
Signed mandate stating the designated tax representative if the directors are tax non-residents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the NIF application, correct the information in Form 036/037 and provide supplementary corporate documents. If TGSS rejects registration, rectify identification data and resubmit through the online RED system or at the provincial TGSS office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ayuntamiento (Municipal Licensing Department / Concejalía de Actividades e Industrial), and competent Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the Autonomous Community, subject to the size and location of the facility
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de apertura y funcionamiento del establecimiento industrial / Licencia de actividad clasificada (formerly 'licencia de apertura')

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico; in autonomous communities, the Consejería de Medio Ambiente
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Annex II, Group 1, Ley 21/2013 (Environmental Impact Assessment) — simplified EIA screening for non-ferrous metal foundries not exceeding Annex I thresholds. The competent authority may require a full EIA if significant negative effects are identified. A smaller die-casting plant may instead fall under municipal environmental licensing or a lesser 'comunicación ambiental' regime.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewer must comply with local sewer ordinances and generally with Real Decreto 817/2015: pH 5.5-9.5, COD ≤ 400 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 300 mg/L, zinc ≤ 3 mg/L, copper ≤ 1 mg/L. VOCs from degreasing and tampprinting processes must comply with Real Decreto 117/2003 and EC solvent emission limits, generally VOC ≤ 50 mg C/Nm³. Waste, including zinc dross and filtration dust, must be classified and managed in accordance with Ley 7/2022 on waste and circular economy.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the fire safety certificate (Certificado de instalación de protección contra incendios) from an authorized maintenance company and register it with Dirección General de Protección Civil; submit structural load inspections in accordance with Código Técnico de la Edificación (DB-SI/DB-SE); and comply with occupational risk prevention requirements under Ley 31/1995 de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, including the workplace safety evaluation, electrical installation inspection, and machinery conformity declarations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - portal: www.agenciatributaria.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL), the incorporating notary must obtain a provisional NIF/CIF from AEAT; the definitive NIF is issued after inscription in the Mercantile Registry. Foreign non-resident entities undertaking taxable activities in Spain must file form 036/037 with the competent AEAT delegation, attaching an apostilled certificate of incorporation, proof of legal representative appointment, a power of attorney, and a valid passport, to obtain a NIF-IVA (where applicable for EU operators).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not provide a US-style check-the-box election; an SL is always entity-level taxed under the Spanish Corporate Income Tax Law (Ley 27/2014). Voluntary elections include joining a consolidated corporate tax group under art. 42, opting for the ETVE/participation exemption regime, and applying the special simplified VAT regime only where statutorily permitted. Hybrid mismatch rules derived from ATAD are mandatory and not electable; no transactional pass-through or transparent classification is available for a standard SL.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold; any SL carrying out economic activities must register in the VAT census (model 036/037) before commencing operations, irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory under Ley 18/2022 (Crea y Crece) for all businesses, phased from 2025/2026, using Facturae or equivalent structured XML format. Large companies with turnover exceeding EUR 6,000,000 must file SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) VAT records within 4 days of issuance; AEAT does not operate a real-time fiscal stamping or clearance platform, but electronic invoices must be securely stored and traceable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated IVA (0%) applies to supplies of goods dispatched or transported by the seller, buyer, or third party to a destination outside the EU, provided the goods are physically removed from Spain (art. 21.1º Ley 37/1992 IVA Act) and the seller retains unequivocal evidence of the export. Certain ancillary services linked to those exported goods are also zero-rated under art. 21.5º.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Documento Único Administrativo (DUA) - Customs Export Declaration
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill/CMR) evidencing physical exit from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT confirmation of receipt of foreign currency funds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If zero-ratng is disallowed because export evidence is insufficient, the SL is liable for 21% IVA, late-payment interest, and penalty surcharges ranging from 50% to 150% of the tax loss (arts. 191-192 Ley General Tributaria 58/2003). Fraudulent export zero-rating in excess of EUR 120,000 triggers criminal liability under art. 305 of the Spanish Criminal Code, with imprisonment up to 6 years and potential clawback of all improperly zero-rated amounts in a retrospective root cause audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) as the national competent authority, with the Dirección General de Transacciones Exteriores (DGTE) of the Secretaría General de Comercio e Inversiones under the Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa as the foreign-exchange and capital-movement supervisory body; the European Central Bank (ECB) holds ultimate monetary policy authority for the euro, and the European Commission enforces Article 63 TFEU free movement of capital.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in both current and capital account operations. Spain applies the EU single-market regime: no general exchange control approvals exist for capital imports, dividend repatriation, or trade payments. Non-resident shareholding in an SL is lawful (capital account liberalized under Law 19/2003), and profit remittance is unrestricted, subject only to (i) inbound/outbound statistical declaration thresholds (Banco de España's balance-of-payments forms, including E-1 for foreign direct investment and C-1 declarations for settlements exceeding statutory thresholds), (ii) AML/CFT verification by the correspondent bank, and (iii) non-resident withholding tax (NRIT) on dividend distributions at 19%, reduced to 0% for qualifying EU/EEA corporate shareholders under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (Law 27/2014, Art. 21) and further reduced under applicable double-tax treaties. No prior authorization or repatriation licence is required for dividends, invested capital, or liquidation proceeds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export proceeds. A Spanish SL may retain receivables in USD, CNY, or other convertible currencies in non-resident or resident foreign-currency collection accounts at authorized credit institutions, or convert freely to EUR at the market exchange rate. The only compliance obligations are statistical: periodic reporting of export settlements through the EORI-linked Intrastat/Extrastat declarations to the customs authorities and, where applicable, the Banco de España's operations declaration for intra-group flows. No profit-remittance approval gate applies, and no central-bank authorization is needed for warehousing export proceeds offshore.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (cuenta de constitución) and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: High as a peripheral payment/disbursement rail, Medium as the sole corporate treasury anchor. Legally, EU-regulated electronic-money institutions (EMIs) — including Spanish entrants licensed by Banco de España under Law 21/2011 and passporting EU EMIs under PSD2 and Directive 2009/110/EC — may open EUR and multi-currency accounts for an SL without a physical branch. Key constraints: EMIs cannot grant credit, are not covered by the Spanish Deposit Guarantee Fund, must safeguard client funds in ring-fenced accounts, and usually lack documentary trade (LC issuance), capital-escrow, and notarial services. For this die-cast exporter, an EMI is advisable only for cross-border vendor disbursements (e.g., Wise, PayPal, multibank aggregators) and should be complemented by a tier-1 credit institution for the statutory capital escrow, FX hedging, and supplier LCs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under Spanish AML Law 10/2010 (Art. 8) and Royal Decree 304/2014, non-face-to-face onboarding is legally permissible where the bank uses advanced electronic signature or recognized video-identification technology. In practice, Santander, BBVA, and CaixaBank require a physical appointment for the SL's authorized signatories and a UBO-identity interview at a commercial branch (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia) when the UBO is a non-EU resident; remote onboarding is generally available only for existing EU-tax-resident directors with a Spanish NIE and a completed compliance questionnaire. Recommended protocol: open the capital escrow account with a notarized power of attorney (escritura de apoderamiento) executed at a Spanish consulate, then complete one branch visit for the operational account signature book; Bankinter and some private-banking desks accept fully remote onboarding under a heightened-due-diligence waiver.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO identified as tax-resident in a FATF high-risk or partially compliant jurisdiction (e.g., certain LATAM or Middle-Eastern countries)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FATF-recognized compliance certificate; recent tax-residence certificates from the UBO's jurisdiction; audited source-of-wealth affidavit; corporate organizational chart of the UBO; notarized passport copies; 12-month bank statements evidencing legitimate accumulation of capital; sworn declaration of no pending criminal or financial investigations; external financial-forensics opinion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent or opaque beneficial ownership structure (nominee shareholders, layered holding companies upstream of the SL)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full share-register transcript (Libro Registro de Socios) certified by the SL's administrator; final-UBO declaration form pursuant to Royal Decree 304/2014; each layer's constitutional documents and registry certificates (Registro Mercantil equivalents in the UBO's chain); notarized trust or nominee disclaimers; explanation letter mapping capital trails from the ultimate owner to the SL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business-purpose mismatch between the corporate object (ISIC 3240 die-cast scale models) and expected payment flows (large intra-group capital, high-frequency small invoices)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed distribution agreements with EU, UK, and LATAM collectible miniature wholesalers; pro-forma invoices and purchase orders from tier-1 distributors; the SL's lease or warehouse contract in Spain; customs import/export declarations (EORI-linked) for zinc-alloy raw materials; photographs or video of molds and tampo-printing facility; the approved escritura de constitución with the ISIC 3240 corporate purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Direct or indirect name match against sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media watchlists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative-screen results from independent sanctions/PEP databases (Dow Jones, LexisNexis) run on all directors and shareholders; formal negative-PEP declaration; confirmation that no EU or OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions are involved; senior-management override memo; external KYC consultant's adverse-media remediation report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexpected third-party or shareholder funding inconsistent with the SL's declared share-capital formation procedure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarial deed of incorporation and the bank's capital-escrow certificate (certificado de la cuenta de constitución under Art. 62 Ley de Sociedades de Capital); loan agreement with the shareholder if a shareholder advance was used; SWIFT MT103 traces showing the shareholder account as sole remitter; board minutes approving capital increases; audited financial statements of the shareholder company.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for the USD or EUR capital contribution: the shareholder remits via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to the SL's Spanish account; the beneficiary name must exactly match the SL's registered name; and the remitter must be the sole UBO/shareholder registered in the corporate records. The bank will file the Banco de España's E-1 foreign-direct-investment declaration tag when the injection exceeds €3,000,000 (or when the transaction represents more than 20% of SL capital) and will require the corporate deed, share-register certificate, and board resolution evidencing the capital increase. Funds must first be placed in the bank's blocked cuenta de constitución during formation and released to the operational account only after Registro Mercantil registration; for an existing SL, the injection is treated as a share-capital increase (ampliación de capital) evidenced by public deed and registered with the Commercial Registry. The bank will verify the AML purpose code (balance-of-payments capital-transaction code) and will suspend the credit if the remitter appears on EU sanctions lists (EU Regulation 269/2014) or if the funds originate from a non-cooperative jurisdiction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Standard rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for open-account supplier prepayments (zinc alloy ingots, die tooling) with full invoice and incoterms references, settled via the bank's correspondent in the supplier's currency; (2) SEPA Credit Transfer (SEPA CT) and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for EU vendors in EUR; (3) Irrevocable Confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit (UCP 600) issued via BBVA or CaixaBank for large Chinese or Taiwanese foundry purchases, covering commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and certificate of origin, payable at sight; (4) documentary collection (cash against documents / documents against acceptance) for mid-value purchases; (5) PayPal or Wise-facilitated mass payouts for B2C collectible sales. The SL must maintain a valid EORI number for customs declarations, and all non-EEA business-to-business payments above €10,000 must be supported by invoices and, where applicable, the C-1 balance-of-payments declaration, ensuring an auditable clearing path for Banco de España and future DAC7/CRS reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD outright forwards (deliverable) under an ISDA master agreement or CNMV-recognized OTC framework
EUR/USD and EUR/GBP FX swaps for rolling working-capital conversion
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD) for term hedging of USD-denominated supplier payments
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on offshore CNH/CNY pairs for Chinese foundry settlements, priced off CNH fixings
Plain-vanilla EUR/USD call and put options and barrier options for treasury risk management with ECB-compliant documentation
NDF-based FX forwards on currencies without deliverable markets, including emerging-market currencies used by LATAM distributors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (depósito de cuentas anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil of the province where the SL has its registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting; approval must take place within six months after the financial year end. For a 31 December year-end, filing must be completed by 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: After one month of delay, the company is barred from recording new deeds (cierre registral). Late filing penalties start at EUR 1,200 plus EUR 200 per month of delay; continued non-compliance may lead to closure of the registry file and blocking of all subsequent corporate filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual legalization of statutory electronic accounting books (legalización de libros de contabilidad)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil of the province where the SL has its registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the financial year end; for a 31 December year-end, by 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-legalized books lose evidentiary value in corporate and tax disputes; the registry may impose an administrative fine up to EUR 1,500; repeated non-compliance reinforces the registry closure penalty on the company's file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after the six-month period following the annual accounting close; for a 31 December year-end, by 25 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs late-delivery surcharge ranging from 5% to 20% of the unpaid tax, plus late-payment interest; underassessment penalties range from 50% to 150% of the additional tax due. No administrative strike-off applies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if at two consecutive financial year ends the SL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds: total assets over EUR 4,000,000; annual net turnover over EUR 8,000,000; average annual employees over 50. Audit is additionally mandatory for listed, financial, insurance, and public-interest entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad, Real Decreto 1514/2007) with sectoral adaptations; national GAAP is harmonized with EU accounting directives. Full EU-IFRS applies to entities listed on EU regulated markets and to consolidated groups that require it.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain applies a continuous UBO disclosure regime. Identified beneficial owners are kept in the corporate and central UBO registers; the annual accounts deposit confirms the shareholder structure as at the balance-sheet date. Any transfer creating, changing, or terminating beneficial ownership, including indirect holdings, must be submitted to the Registro Mercantil within 10 business days. There is no separate fixed-date annual UBO form.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 - USD 900 (approx. EUR 420 - EUR 840) for registered office, corporate administration and local compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 15,000 (approx. EUR 4,500 - EUR 14,000) for a statutory audit only when the compulsory thresholds are exceeded

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D deductions (up to 100% of eligible costs), innovation tax incentives, SME reduced rate of 23% for turnover under EUR 2 million

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) through Agencia Tributaria Sede Electrónica
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 30 April following the end of the tax period for calendar year companies

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base before deductions and tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents file the same form; may require a tax representative for Spanish tax matters

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable deductions including R&D and other incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents generally limited to deductions related to Spanish source income
Calculated by applying 25% to the taxable base after deductions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 100 euros per day of delay, maximum 1,500 euros; 0.5% of the tax due per day of delay; criminal liability for fraudulent filings

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain a Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) from the Spanish tax authorities or relevant competent authority and submit it to the withholding agent before payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory rate (reduced to 0-10% under applicable DTAs); Interest: 19% statutory rate (reduced to 0-10% under applicable DTAs)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 250,000 in related party transactions for Local File; EUR 50 million in consolidated net turnover for Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations apply to entities engaged in IP holding, distribution, or certain service activities; non-compliance may result in recharacterization of profits and imposition of penalties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income or overstatement of expenses to reduce tax liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines equivalent to 100% of the evaded tax; imprisonment for up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal criminal liability and disqualification from corporate management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining a company without genuine economic activity or substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to EUR 600,000; possible dissolution of the entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors held jointly and severally liable for tax obligations; potential criminal prosecution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct customer due diligence or report suspicious activities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 2,000,000; possible criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and disqualification from management positions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-compliance with arm's length principle or failure to prepare TP documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 25% of the tax adjustment; interest on unpaid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for willful violations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends, interest, or royalties without withholding tax or without obtaining TRC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 100% of the unpaid tax; criminal penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal liability for the tax due and possible imprisonment
